mapper.select: SELECT c.*, p.name AS product_name, p.image_url AS product_image FROM cart_item c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY c.id DESC

SELECT c.*, p.name AS product_name, p.image_url AS product_image FROM cart_item c LEFT JOIN products p ON c.product_id = p.id WHERE c.user_id = #{userId} AND c.product_id = #{productId} AND (#{skuSpec} IS NULL OR c.sku_spec = #{skuSpec})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cart_item(user_id, product_id, sku_spec, price, quantity) VALUES(#{userId}, #{productId}, #{skuSpec}, #{price}, #{quantity})

INSERT INTO cart_item(user_id, product_id, sku_spec, price, quantity) VALUES(#{userId}, #{productId}, #{skuSpec}, #{price}, #{quantity}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE price = VALUES(price), quantity = quantity + VALUES(quantity)
mapper.update: UPDATE cart_item SET quantity = #{quantity} WHERE id = #{id}
